description: Create or update a reference-based character for repeatable faceless story generation. A new character with reference images also starts one take of its 3x3 sheet (identity for a person, product for a product, location for a place; about 6.7 credits) and returns it as sheet; pass sheet: none to skip it. If the sheet cannot start, the character is still saved and sheet.error says why.

confirmLikenessConsent.description: For a human character, set true only after the user confirms consent to use the depicted person's likeness.

confirmRightsToReferences.description: Set true only after the user confirms they own the reference media or have permission to use it.

sheet.description: auto: a new character with reference images starts one sheet take (about 6.7 credits). none: no sheet.

subject.description: What the character depicts, which picks its sheet. null: person for human and fictional, product for other. A place is type other with subject location.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace UUID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

name: characters_apply

photoAngles.description: Which angles the reference photos cover (free, cached per photo, never blocks the write). Missing angles come with a tip each; the identity sheet invents them and they can drift. Null without reference photos or when the check could not run.

sheet.description: The sheet started with a new character: kind, jobId and estimatedCredits, or jobId null with error. Null when none was started. Wait with generation_jobs_get.

title: Apply Reusable Character
